topic_ko: 생존에서 잉여로 — 사냥 기술 발달과 여유
_note: 원문 유형은 글의 순서. order 유형을 가장 강하게 출제. 유형마다 passage 를 다르게 paraphrase.

passage: For the vast majority of animals, simply staying alive demands every hour of the day.
Locating food and water, staying warm, escaping predators, and reproducing drain all of their energy.
Whatever brief moments remain are usually given over to rest or sleep.
The same relentless pressure once weighed upon our own distant ancestors.
The unending search for food placed enormous demands on their lives.
Yet as they gradually became sharper, more skillful hunters, their circumstances began to shift.
The key to this change was the growth of far greater intelligence, which let them kill prey with brain rather than brawn.
In time, when prey was abundant and their techniques refined, they enjoyed real surplus and even leisure.
choices: how growing intelligence freed early humans from a constant struggle to survive
why most animals fail to develop tools for hunting their prey
how predators learned to cooperate in order to hunt larger animals
why early farming replaced hunting as the main source of food
how sleep and rest improve the survival chances of wild animals
theme.explanation_ko: 대부분의 동물은 생존에 모든 시간을 쓰지만, 인간 조상은 지능 발달로 효율적 사냥꾼이 되어 잉여와 여유를 얻었다는 내용. ①이 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ②도구 실패, ③포식자 협력, ④농경의 사냥 대체, ⑤수면의 생존 효과는 본문의 핵심이 아니다.

passage: We should not assume that life has always been a desperate scramble for every creature, including ourselves.
It is true that most animals spend all their time merely staying alive, and our early ancestors once did the same.
But human history shows that this condition can be escaped through the growth of intelligence.
As our ancestors became more efficient hunters, using brain rather than brawn, their situation changed.
We must therefore recognize that mental ability, not physical strength, was the engine of human progress.
Where prey was plentiful and techniques were advanced, people gained surplus food and free time.
That surplus, won by cleverness, is what eventually lifted humanity above mere survival.
We ought to value intelligence as the true source of the prosperity that followed.
choices: 동물은 인간보다 더 효율적으로 먹이를 사냥한다.
인간의 번영을 이끈 진정한 원동력은 신체적 힘이 아니라 지능이다.
수렵 생활은 농경보다 더 안정적인 식량 공급을 보장한다.
여가 시간은 동물의 생존 능력을 약화시킨다.
모든 생물은 생존 투쟁에서 결코 벗어날 수 없다.
claim.explanation_ko: 지능(brain)이 신체적 힘(brawn)을 대신해 인간을 생존 투쟁에서 벗어나게 했고 번영을 이끌었다는 주장. ②가 정답.
claim.distractor_ko: ①③④는 근거 없고, ⑤는 본문의 '벗어날 수 있다'와 정반대이다.

passage: Most animals must devote all their waking hours to the simple task of survival.
Finding food, avoiding danger, and reproducing leave them no time for anything else.
Our earliest ancestors once lived under exactly this kind of pressure.
The constant hunt for food made heavy demands on every part of their lives.
However, as they slowly evolved into more efficient hunters, everything began to change.
Their secret was greater intelligence, which let them outsmart prey instead of overpowering it.
Eventually, with rich prey and skilled methods, they reached a level of genuine prosperity.
For the first time, they had time on their hands rather than a struggle to fill it.
choices: 동물은 잉여 에너지가 있을 때만 놀이를 한다.
사냥 기술이 발달할수록 식량은 오히려 부족해진다.
지능 발달 덕분에 인간 조상은 생존 투쟁에서 벗어나 여유를 얻었다.
농경의 시작이 인류 번영의 유일한 원인이었다.
신체적 힘이 강한 동물일수록 더 오래 생존한다.
gist.explanation_ko: 생존에 모든 시간을 쏟던 인간 조상이 지능 발달로 효율적 사냥꾼이 되어 잉여와 여가를 얻었다는 것이 요지. ③.
gist.distractor_ko: ①놀이, ②식량 부족, ④농경, ⑤신체적 힘은 요지가 아니다.

passage: For nearly every animal, the struggle to survive consumes the entire day.
Our distant ancestors were no exception, driven endlessly by the need to find food.
But a quiet revolution slowly transformed their lives.
As they grew into more efficient hunters, the old pressures began to ease.
The secret lay in intelligence: they used brain, not brawn, to bring down their prey.
Where game was abundant and skills were sharp, they began to enjoy a surplus.
By the close of the long hunting era, they already tasted a degree of affluence.
At last, they had time on their hands — the first sign of true prosperity.
choices: From Survival to Surplus: How Intelligence Freed Our Ancestors
Why Animals Never Stop Hunting for Food
The Birth of Farming and the End of the Wild
How Physical Strength Won the Battle for Survival
Sleep and Rest: The Hidden Needs of Every Creature
title.explanation_ko: 지능 덕분에 생존(survival)에서 잉여(surplus)·번영으로 나아간 인간 조상을 압축한 ①이 제목.
title.distractor_ko: ②동물의 끝없는 사냥, ③농경의 탄생, ④신체적 힘, ⑤수면·휴식은 초점이 아니다.

passage: For most animals, every hour is swallowed by the work of staying alive.
Our early ancestors once faced the same unbroken demand for food.
But as they evolved into more efficient hunters, their world began to change.
They killed prey with cleverness rather than raw force, relying on growing intelligence.
Where game was plentiful and methods were advanced, they reached real prosperity.
By the end of the hunting era, before farming began, they were already enjoying some affluence.
For the first time in their long history, they had time on their hands.
Survival no longer claimed every waking moment of their existence.
implication.underlined: they had time on their hands
choices: they were forced to hunt even longer each day
they had free time beyond what mere survival required
they lost the skills their ancestors had developed
they grew anxious about the future supply of food
they returned to depending only on physical strength
implication.explanation_ko: '시간이 손에 남아돌았다'는 표현은 생존에 필요한 것을 넘어선 여유 시간이 생겼음을 뜻한다. ②가 정답.
implication.distractor_ko: ①더 긴 사냥, ③기술 상실, ④불안, ⑤힘 의존은 '여유'와 반대이거나 무관하다.

passage: For most animals the struggle to survive takes up all their time.
If they do have any time to spare, they spend it resting or sleeping.
This was also true for our early ancestors, on whom the constant search for food put heavy demands.
But as they slowly evolved into more and more efficient hunters, the situation changed.
The secret of their success was the development of much greater intelligence.
They used brain not brawn killing their prey.
In certain regions the prey was plentiful enough for them to experience real prosperity.
At the end of the long hunting era, they were already enjoying some degree of affluence.
grammar._grammar_note: ④ 'killing' 이 비문법. 목적('먹이를 죽이기 위해')을 나타내는 부사적 to부정사 'to kill' 이 와야 한다.
grammar.explanation_ko: '근력이 아니라 두뇌를 사용했다'는 목적의 의미이므로 ④는 분사 'killing' 이 아니라 목적의 to부정사 'to kill' 이어야 한다. ④가 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ① takes up(차지하다), ② spend + 목적어 + -ing/it, ③ 전치사+관계대명사 on whom, ⑤ enough for + 의미상주어 + to부정사는 모두 옳다.

passage: For most animals the struggle to survive takes up all their time.
Finding food, keeping warm, avoiding predators, and reproducing consume all their energies.
Our early ancestors faced the same constant pressure from the search for food.
But as they slowly evolved into more efficient hunters, the situation changed.
The secret of their success was the development of much greater intelligence.
They used brain, not brawn, to kill their prey.
In certain regions the prey was sufficiently scarce for them to experience real prosperity.
By the end of the hunting era they were already enjoying a degree of affluence.
vocab._vocab_note: ⑤ 'scarce' 가 의도적 오답. 풍부한 먹이로 번영을 누렸다는 맥락이므로 'plentiful' 이 적절하다.
vocab.explanation_ko: 먹이가 충분히 '풍부(plentiful)'해서 번영을 누렸다는 맥락이므로 ⑤ 'scarce(부족한)'는 정반대의 낱말이다. ⑤가 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①투쟁 ②소모하다 ③효율적인 ④근력은 문맥상 모두 적절하다.

passage: For most animals, survival takes up all their time, and our early ancestors were no different.
The constant search for food once placed heavy demands upon them.
But as they slowly evolved into more and more efficient hunters, the situation changed.
The secret of their success was the development of much greater intelligence.
They used brain, not brawn, to kill their prey.
In certain regions, prey was plentiful and their techniques advanced enough for real prosperity.
By the close of the hunting era, they were already enjoying a degree of affluence.
For the first time, they had time on their hands.
blank.explanation_ko: 빈칸 뒤에서 'brain, not brawn(근력이 아닌 두뇌)'으로 사냥했다고 했으므로 성공의 비결은 '지능(intelligence)'이다.
blank.distractor_ko: ①힘 ③인내 ④운 ⑤속도는 'brain not brawn' 단서와 연결되지 않는다.

irrelevant.intro: For most animals the struggle to survive takes up all their time, and this was also true for our early ancestors.
sentences: The constant search for food would have placed heavy demands upon them.
But as they slowly evolved into more and more efficient hunters, the situation changed.
The secret of their success was the development of much greater intelligence, used to outsmart their prey.
Modern zoos carefully design enclosures to keep captive animals physically active and healthy.
By the end of the hunting era, with plentiful prey and refined techniques, they were already enjoying real prosperity.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: 글은 '생존 투쟁 → 지능 발달 → 잉여·번영'의 흐름인데 ④ '현대 동물원의 사육장 설계'는 무관하다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②③⑤는 모두 인간 조상의 사냥과 번영이라는 흐름에 연결된다.

order.given: For most animals the struggle to survive takes up all their time. Finding food and drink, keeping warm and clean, avoiding predators, migrating and reproducing use up all their energies. This was also true for our early ancestors.

blocks.A: But as they slowly evolved into more and more efficient hunters, the situation changed. The secret of their success was the development of much greater intelligence; they used brain not brawn to kill their prey.
blocks.B: The constant search for food would have put heavy demands upon them, just as it does on animals today, leaving little time for anything beyond survival itself.
blocks.C: At the end of the long hunting era, before they turned to farming, they were already enjoying some degree of affluence. In certain regions the prey was plentiful enough for a remarkable degree of prosperity, and they had time on their hands.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글이 '조상도 마찬가지였다'로 끝나면 (B)가 그 식량 탐색의 부담을 부연하고, (A)에서 'But ... 효율적 사냥꾼'으로 전환하며, (C)가 그 결과인 잉여·번영을 제시한다. (B)-(A)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (C)의 잉여·번영은 (A)의 지능 발달 이후 결과이므로 먼저 올 수 없고, (A)의 But 전환도 (B)의 부담 서술 뒤라야 자연스럽다.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장의 'the situation changed(상황이 바뀌었다)'는 ② 뒤, 즉 조상의 식량 부담을 말한 다음 변화를 알리는 자리에 와야 하고, 그 변화의 비결(지능)이 바로 뒤따른다. ②가 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: ②에 넣지 않으면 'The secret of their new success' 의 'success(성공)'가 가리킬 변화가 앞에 나타나지 않는다.

The constant search for food placed heavy demands upon them.
But as they evolved into more efficient hunters, the situation changed.
They used brain rather than brawn, relying on much greater intelligence.
Where prey was plentiful and techniques advanced, they reached real prosperity.

Survival no longer claimed every moment of their lives.
summary.summary_template: Although early humans once spent all their time __(A)__ , the rise of intelligence made them efficient hunters and gave them a surplus of food and __(B)__ .
summary.explanation_ko: 초기 인간은 (A)생존(surviving)에 모든 시간을 썼으나 지능 발달로 식량 잉여와 (B)여가(leisure)를 얻었다. ①.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 farming/resting 이 아니라 surviving, (B)는 danger/hunger 가 아니라 leisure 여야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그들은 먹이를 죽이기 위해 근력이 아니라 두뇌를 사용했다.
writing.answer: They used brain not brawn to kill their prey.
writing.explanation_ko: 목적의 to부정사 'to kill', 대조 표현 'brain not brawn'.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 대부분의 동물에게 생존을 위한 투쟁은 그들의 모든 시간을 차지한다.
writing.answer: For most animals the struggle to survive takes up all their time.
writing.explanation_ko: 전치사구 For most animals 가 앞, 주어 the struggle to survive + takes up + all their time.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그들이 더욱 효율적인 사냥꾼으로 진화하면서, 그 상황은 바뀌었다.
conditions: 비교급 강조 표현 more and more 를 사용할 것
writing.answer: As they evolved into more and more efficient hunters, the situation changed.
writing.explanation_ko: 시간·이유의 as + more and more efficient(점점 더 효율적인) + 주절 the situation changed.

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: The real secret of the early hunters' success was not their physical power but their much greater ___________.
writing.explanation_ko: 본문에서 성공의 비결은 신체적 힘이 아니라 'intelligence(지능)'의 발달이다.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: At the end of the long hunting era, before they turned to farming, they were already enjoying some degree of affluence.
writing.answer: 오랜 사냥 시대의 끝 무렵, 그들이 농경으로 돌아서기 전에, 그들은 이미 어느 정도의 풍요를 누리고 있었다.
writing.explanation_ko: before they turned to farming(농경으로 전환하기 전에), some degree of affluence(어느 정도의 풍요).
